results.description:
Are heroes born or made? Find out where Ben Hope’s story started in the novellas that reveal where the journey began…

PASSENGER 13: SAS soldier Ben Hope is on leave from the Second Gulf War, only to find himself embroiled in an intrigue deadlier than anything he encountered on the battlefields. An aircraft flown by a former comrade has crashed off the Cayman Islands killing all passengers, apparently due to pilot suicide. But something doesn’t add up. Who was the mysterious thirteenth passenger on board and why are powerful forces determined to suppress the answer at any cost?

BRING HIM BACK: Ben Hope is fresh out of the SAS. His first case as a kidnap and recovery specialist is a missing twelve-year old boy, snatched from his home on Jersey. His mother realises that if she ever wants to see her son again, she'll need someone with some very special skills to find him. But as Ben begins his search, he soon discovers that nothing about this case is as it seems…

About the author

Scott Mariani is the author of the worldwide-acclaimed action / adventure series featuring maverick ex-SAS hero Ben Hope, and also the historical series of Will Bowman novels. Scott’s books have topped the bestseller charts in the UK and beyond. Scott was born in Scotland, studied in Oxford and now lives and writes in rural west Wales.
